title: Consider optional radio key export and import
description: Explicitly deferred by Mark on2026-09-09. Radios may choose to support user-facing identity-key extraction/export and import in future; not required for baseline radio-owned identity. Do not implement endpoints, automatic phone-mediated portability, key backup/sync or migration now. When explicitly resumed, design authenticated user-authorized transfer, compatibility with upstreamYggidentity and existing provisioning, handling of replay/nonce state and possible simultaneous use of copied identity; key transfer alone does not imply transferring inbox/custody or every security context. No format or migration behavior is selected by this placeholder.
acceptance_criteria: Remain deferred until Mark resumes it. Future design defines optional capability and safe identity/security-state lifecycle with independent tests and three code reviews if implemented; production OSCORE internals keep their human-only edit bar. No baseline conformance dependency on key export/import.
notes: Mark chose radio-owned identity and explicitly deferred optional key extraction/import; no automatic resume date.
